## The Smooze (G4)

Not actually a pony: the Smooze is Discord’s cheerful, semi-transparent lime-green **slime friend** and Grand Galloping Gala guest, remembered for a tiny face, pale-blue top hat, red bow tie, and a voracious appetite for gemstones. The blob expands into magic-resistant ooze when fed jewels.

**Name and continuity.** “The Smooze” is spoken in *Friendship Is Magic*, not a fan-assigned name. Discord jokingly calls the creature “Smooze Face,” “the Smoozinator,” and “Smoozie”; these are nicknames, not secret identities. The name and concept revive the purple, dangerous Smooze created by Hydia in [*My Little Pony: The Movie* (1986)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/My_Little_Pony%3A_The_Movie_%281986_film%29), but G4’s friendly green creature is a reinterpretation, not a verified single individual across continuities. IDW’s [*My Little Pony: Generations*](https://westfieldcomics.com/product/22050553/my-little-pony-generations-sc-idw-publishing) introduces yet another Smooze threat in its G1/G4 crossover; do not conflate that plot with Discord’s guest.

**Voice and appearances.** The G4 Smooze makes gooey noises but has no intelligible spoken dialogue or verified individual voice-actor credit. The starring appearance is *Make New Friends but Keep Discord* (S5E7, 2015); a brief return alongside Discord occurs during “Lotta Little Things” in *Between Dark and Dawn* (S9E13; [official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O-kQRGlvp8o)).

**Show still** — *Friendship Is Magic*, S5E7; animation credited to the Hasbro Studios production:

## Important moments

All four scenes occur in [*Make New Friends but Keep Discord* (S5E7), official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FWqiJJ3ied4). Exact scene timestamps could not be independently verified.

1. **Discord’s surprising plus-one (S5E7):** Discord presents the Smooze as an old friend at the Gala, using the guest to disguise his jealousy of Fluttershy and Tree Hugger. *Timestamp unavailable.*
2. **Gems become a ballroom disaster (S5E7):** Feasting on jewels swells the Smooze until the ballroom is engulfed in goo that Twilight and Celestia cannot dispel with magic. *Timestamp unavailable.*
3. **Tree Hugger finds the answer (S5E7):** Her soothing vocal vibrations calm the Smooze when magical intervention fails, making empathy more useful than force. *Timestamp unavailable.*
4. **An apology and a dance (S5E7):** Discord apologizes for neglecting the Smooze; Pinkie Pie then invites the happy blob to dance, completing the episode’s friendship lesson. *Timestamp unavailable.*

For dialogue and scene sequence, see the [episode transcript](https://www.springfieldspringfield.co.uk/view_episode_scripts.php?episode=s05e07&tv-show=my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic).
